items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: But we had to rent a banjo player named (?)Sugar Do(?)

ctx.x: Well, like I said, it wasn't too many younger guys that could play real good, not at our age. I can't remember any...there wasn't a darn kid in school... Except I had a little cousin named Lionel who played drums pretty good. But we had to rent a banjo player named (?)Sugar Do(?), and Edmond...a guy with a French name...Edmond Gautier; he played drums sometimes. I'm trying to think of the bass player's name we used to have. I can't think of his name.
